Module sudoku
Package sudoku.model

Class Game

java.lang.Object
sudoku.model.Game
public class Game extends Object
A Sudoku game. It keeps the board and the hints left, and it is the class the controller talks to: it receives the moves of the player, checks them with the Sudoku rules, and gives hints. The first board comes from a generator.

    • placeNumber

      public MoveResult placeNumber(int row, int column, int value)
      Puts a number in a cell and checks it. If the number repeats in its row, column or block, it is still placed, but the cells in conflict are returned so they can be highlighted.
      Parameters:
      row - row of the cell
      column - column of the cell
      value - number to put (1 to 6)
      Returns:
      the result of the move, with a message for the player

    • requestHint

      public Hint requestHint()
      Gives a hint: a number that can be placed in an empty cell without breaking the rules. It does not place the number; the player decides. Each hint uses one of the limited hints, so the board cannot be finished using only hints.
      Returns:
      the hint, or null if there are no hints left or no cell can receive a number
